_schema.note: This is the differentiator and it depends ONLY on the English name, never on the user. Compute once, serve forever. ~3,000 rows.

fields.name: English given name
fields.commonality: very_common | common | uncommon | rare — grounded in SSA popularity data, not model intuition
fields.peak_decade: decade of peak US popularity, or 'current' or null if never charted meaningfully
fields.intl_student_cliche: boolean — disproportionately chosen by Chinese international students
fields.risk_flags: array of flag objects with a type and localized note

_schema.grounding_note: commonality and peak_decade MUST be joined against US Social Security Administration name data (public domain, per-year counts back to 1880) rather than generated. Only the qualitative feel fields are model-authored.
